reuse.why: Replaces three identical inline category queries with one new helper and reuses the existing getBudgetData/setBudget flow, though copyPreviousMonth does not use the new helper.

duplication.why: Removes the triplicated SQL, but the hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion rule now exists twice: as SQL in getBulkBudgetCategories and as JS checks in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection helper lives in actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use it, matching where the tree keeps this logic.

scope.why: Focused on the month-wide actions; only a minor unrelated reformatting of the Pick type in getBudgetData.

maintainability.why: A maintainer changing the exclusion rule must remember to update both the SQL helper and copyPreviousMonth's inline predicate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth applies its own inline hidden/group_hidden/goal_def checks instead of the new getBulkBudgetCategories selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The exclusion rule is re-expressed as JS conditions in copyPreviousMonth (hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1; goal_def != null) mirroring the SQL WHERE clause in getBulkBudgetCategories.

one_place.where: Rule defined in getBulkBudgetCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and separately in copyPreviousMonth's forEach checks in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts.
